---
title: Comment characters
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'cell-id: "annotated-cell-1", annotations: \("1": 1\)'
          - 'cell-id: "annotated-cell-5", annotations: \("1": 1\)'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
          - '<1>'
          - '/\* <1>'
          - '-- <'
---

```{.c}
int x = 1;  /* <1> */
```

1. C.

```{.js}
let x = 1;  // <1>
```

1. JS.

```{.sql}
SELECT 1;  -- <1>
```

1. SQL.

```{.matlab}
x = 1;  % <1>
```

1. MATLAB.

```{.bash}
echo hi  # <1>
```

1. Bash.
